historical_adaptations.marker: SCP-JP Wikidot Foxtrot WebKit row endpoint: contain the fourth submenu where the engine keeps all parents on one row.
historical_adaptations.rationale: In WebKit at 390px all four native JP menu parents stay on one row. The fourth submenu expands even the closed document beyond the viewport; the unthemed state fits. Right-anchor this row endpoint only in WebKit at 360–767px. Native normal and all eight navigation actions pass; the wrapped 320px row and other engines retain their existing anchors.
